Hi all — thanks for the context, Samantha. I pulled together concise answers below and attached a redacted sample export. High-level answers first, then a short technical note.

High-level (TL;DR):
- SOC 2: Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II audited (controls for security and availability). We can provide the SOC 2 report under NDA — request via your normal vendor intake process.
- HIPAA/BAA: We support HIPAA scoping for dedicated and private deployments; will sign a BAA for those customers. For the hosted offering, we evaluate on a case-by-case basis and prefer Dedicated/Private for PHI workloads.
- Retention: Default retention for audit logs is 90 days. Customers can configure retention up to 7 years on Dedicated and Private deployments; Hosted customers can request extended retention via contract.
- Exportability: Exports available as NDJSON/CSV. Delivery options: S3 (customer bucket via cross-account), signed download bundle, or streaming via API. Exports include ISO8601 timestamps, event type, resource id, actor id (opaque), request id, and request/response metadata (bodies truncated/redacted by default).
- Immutability / Tamper-evidence: We support append-only internal write-once semantics for audit indices and provide a signed export manifest for delivered bundles. For WORM/Object Lock semantics we recommend configuring S3 Object Lock on your side for hosted exports or enabling Object Lock/HSM-signed manifests in Private deployments.

Technical notes:
- Admin activity logs: records include actor (internal user id or service principal), action, target resource, timestamp, outcome, and request id. We do not log raw secrets or full API keys; we log an opaque API key identifier/token id for correlation.
- API request logs: request path, method, status code, latency, token-id (opaque), model id/version, token counts, client IP (anonymized if requested).
- Immutability details: internally we maintain append-only indices with sequence-numbered segments and cross-check hashes. For delivered exports we generate a signed manifest (SHA256) with per-file checksums and a manifest signature (customer-key or our service key depending on deployment). In Private deployments customers can enable their KMS + HSM signing so manifests are customer-signed.
- PII handling: default export redaction removes payload fields that match configured sensitive-field patterns; we can extend patterns based on your provided data map.

Attachments: redacted sample export (healthcore_sample_audit_export.ndjson) — includes 50 sample events demonstrating admin:create-user, api:request logs, and role-change events.

Recommended next steps:
1) We’ll start populating the questionnaire (target: Tue 20 Jul EOD for the yellow sections).
2) Confirm tech Q&A: Tue 20 Jul 10:00–10:45 PT (we’ll send a calendar invite).
3) If you need WORM guarantees, let us know — we’ll provide an architecture note for Object Lock and customer-side S3 configuration specific to hosted vs private.

Happy to jump on a call during the Q&A to walk through sample events.

Thanks,
